subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is Zuggtmoy's instrument, the corrupted high priestess of House Mizzrym, the reason we had been prisoners in the first place — and she erupted into a cloud of poisonous spores when she died.
source_quote: Ilvara — Zuggtmoy's instrument, the corrupted high priestess of House Mizzrym, the reason we had been prisoners in the first place — folded and went still, and then, because the Underdark does not allow even death to be dignified, she did not simply fall. She *erupted*. A cloud of poisonous spores, billowing outward from what had been a person. A woman who had traded herself to a fungal demon lord, and what was left was biology, not identity. Not even a body. Just spores.

subject: Nym Duskryn
fact: Nym Duskryn was sent to extract Daz, deliver the package intact, get paid — and asked if she could kill his brother after he refused to hide.
source_quote: Can you please keep your head down and out of combat? We only get paid if you live... Can I kill your brother? He was always the dumber of the ones, and if I understood correctly, he's covered in fungus?

subject: Kaelira Duskryn
fact: Kaelira Duskryn grabbed Daz's arm and hauled him northeast through the chittering wall of poison, enforcing his survival without his consent.
source_quote: Come with me if you want to live, you idiot... She was hauling me northeast through the chittering wall of it while the poisonous gas did its work on both of us. She had my arm, she had the direction, and she had strong opinions about my continued survival that she was enforcing without my consent.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree believed Daz and the Duskryn sisters were traitors to Lolth until he smoothly inserted them into her existing framework as Lolth-aligned allies.
source_quote: Who are you? You must be traitors! Traitors to Lolth!... No, these are friends of Lolth, and they're here to help. The words came out smooth. No hesitation, no announcement, no explanation.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum observed that Asha's characterization of Daz as an insane mage who converted to Lolthism was 'accurately described,' with his steady, clear-eyed precision.
source_quote: Grygum, at some point in this sequence, observed that the situation was 'accurately described' by Asha's characterization of me as an insane mage who had converted to Lolthism. He meant it kindly. Or as kindly as Grygum observes anything, which is with the steady, clear-eyed precision of a man keeping accurate records.

subject: Jorlan Duskryn
fact: Jorlan Duskryn was struck by a lightning bolt, staggered across the cavern, and became the target of Nym’s redirected frustration.
source_quote: The lightning bolt that followed was not, technically, my problem. Jorlan Duskryn went staggering across the cavern floor, and Nym's professional frustrations had found their outlet...

subject: Daz
fact: Daz refused to hide, declared he would not leave others to fight for him without participating, and cast a shaped Fireball to protect allies while destroying enemies.
source_quote: I am not gonna leave. Everyone here... to fight for me without me also participating. I don't give a damn if you get paid. The best way for you to get paid, then, is to continue the fight and prevent all of us from dying... I cast Fireball in a shaped arc around everything I wanted to keep.

subject: the cavern
fact: The cavern was filled with a persistent insect bloom and a poison cloud, and the bridge cracked under Ilvara’s weight.
source_quote: The insect bloom still hanging in the air... the poison cloud's range... The bridge cracked under her.

subject: the tunnel mouth
fact: The tunnel mouth was where elite T'sarran drow soldiers stood debating whether to charge, stalled by a wall of insects and insufficient Dispel Magic.
source_quote: The T'sarran soldiers themselves, who were busy at the tunnel mouth having an argument that I can only describe as profoundly unhelpful... Elite drow soldiers... now stymied by a wall of insects and a mage with insufficient spell preparation.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool, the sentient, gentle, luminously good-natured ooze companion, had taken twenty-six points of damage from Ilvara's plague and survived.
source_quote: Glabbagool — our sentient, gentle, luminously good-natured ooze companion who had been, from what I could tell, simply trying to participate in the ambient conversation of the battle — had already taken twenty-six points of damage from Ilvara's plague and survived.

subject: House T'sarran
fact: House T'sarran’s matron mother will hear about the Fireball cast in the cavern — and that is probably going to matter later.
source_quote: The matron mother of House T'sarran will hear about this. She was not wrong. That is probably going to matter later. I filed it accordingly.

subject: House Mizzrym
fact: House Mizzrym is the corrupted high priestess Ilvara’s former house, and the reason the party had been prisoners in the first place.
source_quote: Ilvara — Zuggtmoy's instrument, the corrupted high priestess of House Mizzrym, the reason we had been prisoners in the first place...

subject: the Fireball in the cavern
fact: Daz cast a shaped Fireball around allies, killing Drow warriors and leaving the mage barely standing, who warned that the matron mother of House T'sarran would hear about it.
source_quote: I cast Fireball in a shaped arc around everything I wanted to keep. The cavern went very bright for a moment. The Drow warriors who had been irritated about the Insect Plague were no longer irritated about the Insect Plague. The mage was still standing when the smoke cleared, barely, and she had the presence of mind to deliver her parting observation: 'The matron mother of House T'sarran will hear about this.'

subject: Ilvara's eruption
fact: Ilvara did not simply fall after being struck by the guiding bolt — she erupted into a cloud of poisonous spores, a biological consequence of her pact with Zuggtmoy.
source_quote: She *erupted*. A cloud of poisonous spores, billowing outward from what had been a person. A woman who had traded herself to a fungal demon lord, and what was left was biology, not identity. Not even a body. Just spores.

subject: Daz's refusal to be extracted
fact: Daz refused Nym’s extraction order, declared his intent to fight alongside his companions, and transformed his role from liability to active participant.
source_quote: I am not gonna leave... I don't give a damn if you get paid... Not hiding. Not extracted. Not managed.

subject: the insect plague
fact: The insect plague was a persistent, airborne hazard that filled the cavern, damaged Glabbagool, and irritated the Drow reinforcements.
source_quote: The insect bloom still hanging in the air... the poisonous gas did its work on both of us... the Drow warriors who had been irritated about the Insect Plague...

subject: the poison cloud
fact: The poison cloud was a tactical hazard whose range the Drow reinforcements stepped into, unaware they had committed to a dramatic entrance.
source_quote: the poison cloud's range... the new arrivals were already inside the poison cloud's range... they had stepped into a catastrophe they had no part in making.

subject: the Underdark
fact: The Underdark does not allow even death to be dignified — it forces corpses to erupt, not fall.
source_quote: because the Underdark does not allow even death to be dignified, she did not simply fall. She *erupted*.

subject: the lightning bolt that missed
fact: A lightning bolt was launched into the cavern with real commitment — it hit nothing, just open air and ambition.
source_quote: The mage launched a lightning bolt into the cavern with real commitment. It hit nothing. Just open air and ambition.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir processed the question of unnamed creatures with his characteristic meditative calm and declared 'That's awesome.'
source_quote: Zalthir processed this with his characteristic meditative calm. 'That's awesome.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin's work was referenced as the cause of the bridge cracking under Ilvara — and his name was invoked as the reason Daz refused to leave.
source_quote: The bridge cracked under her. Thorin's work... Everyone here... to fight for me without me also participating.

subject: the Jorlan-Ilvara drama
fact: The romantic betrayal between Jorlan and Ilvara — the scarring, the fury, the way he pursued her through an active insect plague — was noted, filed, and appreciated as emotionally resonant.
source_quote: I was amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama. I want to be clear about that. The romantic betrayal. The scarring. The fury. The way he had broken from us to pursue her through an active insect plague. It was genuinely interesting. I filed it, appreciated it, and continued.

subject: the Lolth-follower identity
fact: Daz maintained a Lolth-follower identity with Asha Vandree long enough that the fiction had its own momentum — he stopped thinking of it as lying and started thinking of it as consistent characterization.
source_quote: I have been maintaining a Lolth-follower identity with Asha Vandree for long enough that the fiction has its own momentum — you learn to stop thinking of it as lying and start thinking of it as consistent characterization.

subject: the transactional argument
fact: Nym’s transactional argument — 'we only get paid if you live' — was noted as logically sound but emotionally irrelevant to Daz, who cared only about participation.
source_quote: I find transactional arguments interesting when they're offered as though they should be persuasive to the person whose life is being treated as currency.

subject: the petty logistical failure
fact: The T'sarran soldiers’ failure — having firepower and numbers but no Dispel Magic — was categorized as aesthetically interesting: not grand collapse, but petty logistical failure.
source_quote: There's a category of failure I find almost aesthetically interesting — not the grand collapse, but the petty logistical one.

subject: the shaped Fireball technique
fact: Daz used Sculpt Spells to carve exceptions into a Fireball, protecting allies while destroying enemies — a skill honed in Menzoberranzan’s destructive arts tradition.
source_quote: An Evoker — and I am an Evoker, trained in Menzoberranzan where the destructive arts were considered the only magic worth taking seriously — learns to carve exceptions into area spells. The ability is called Sculpt Spells...

subject: the feeling of purpose
fact: Daz found, to his own surprise, that purpose felt like standing in the smoke of his own fireball, surrounded by people who were fighting because he refused to leave.
source_quote: I find, somewhat to my own surprise, that this is what purpose feels like.

subject: the cost of Menzoberranzan
fact: Daz privately knows what Menzoberranzan made him and what the Underdark has cost him — slavery, free people, the basis of society — but right now, Asha’s belief is load-bearing.
source_quote: I know all of that. But right now, in this cavern, Asha thinks I serve Lolth, and that belief is load-bearing.
